# clippy cargo

Every lint of the clippy `cargo` group as of Rust 1.99. All are allowed by default.

| Lint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`cargo_common_metadata`](https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/rust-1.99.0/index.html#cargo_common_metadata) | common metadata is defined in `Cargo.toml` |
| [`multiple_crate_versions`](https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/rust-1.99.0/index.html#multiple_crate_versions) | multiple versions of the same crate being used |
| [`negative_feature_names`](https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/rust-1.99.0/index.html#negative_feature_names) | usage of a negative feature name |
| [`redundant_feature_names`](https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/rust-1.99.0/index.html#redundant_feature_names) | usage of a redundant feature name |
| [`wildcard_dependencies`](https://rust-lang.github.io/rust-clippy/rust-1.99.0/index.html#wildcard_dependencies) | wildcard dependencies being used |
